title: The KARNATAKA AADHAAR (TARGETED DELIVERY OF FINANCIAL AND OTHER SUBSIDIES, BENEFITS AND SERVICES) ACT, 2018
full_text: The KARNATAKA AADHAAR (TARGETED DELIVERY OF FINANCIAL AND OTHER SUBSIDIES, BENEFITS AND SERVICES) ACT, 2018 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201810 Act Number: 10 Enactment Date: 2018-03-07 Act Year: 2018 Short Title: The KARNATAKA AADHAAR (TARGETED DELIVERY OF FINANCIAL AND OTHER SUBSIDIES, BENEFITS AND SERVICES) ACT, 2018 Long Title: An Act to provide for, as a good governance measure, efficient, transparent, and targeted delivery of financial and other subsidies, benefits and services, the expenditure for which is incurred from the Consolidated Fund of State to individuals residing in the State of Karnataka using Aadhaar as a sole identifier, and for matters connected therewith.
